hero.title: Customer service that scales with your business
hero.subtitle: In e-commerce, fast customer service is critical to success. Delayed replies to customer inquiries mean lost sales and bad reviews. But staffing customer service 24/7 is expensive and complex.

mainCard.title: AI-powered customer service that never sleeps
mainCard.description: Aibooking.dk gives you AI-powered customer service that never sleeps. The system instantly answers common questions about products, delivery times, returns, and order status. Complex inquiries are automatically escalated to your team. With SMS notifications, you keep customers updated throughout their entire purchase journey. Your dashboard shows all customer interactions, conversation summaries, frequently asked questions, and trends, so you can continuously optimize your service. Reduce response times from hours to seconds and significantly improve customer satisfaction.
